BBA.hodMessage:
Dear students,

Welcome to the Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) department of Nagarjuna Degree College. The BBA program is a 4 year full time Degree course (As per NEP 2020) affiliated to Bengaluru City University (BCU). The Journey of the Department started in the year 2013. Over the years we recorded consistent improvement in its academic, placement, sports and cultural forte. The Department of BBA offers a wide range of innovative programs which is a blend of both curricular and co-curricular which helps the students to constantly update themselves in this competitive era and holistic development of students.

We have semester based BBA Programme with specialisations in three important areas: Marketing management, Finance and Human Resource Management along with Value added Programs (VAP) in each semester.

We believe that our students have been given wide opportunity to get hands on experience in the corporate world through internship projects with reputed organisations. In this curriculum they are encouraged to take up projects to supplement theoretical knowledge with practical experience. We have tied up MOUs with reputed entities to understand the relevance of working in a group.

The department curriculum is taught by distinguished faculty combining academic excellence and commitment. We are confident that our current curriculum has enabled the overall development of budding entrepreneurs, managers, finance analysts, HR managers and so on.

With this brief introduction, I welcome you all to be a part of NDC journey towards being a world class centre of excellence in education, training and research.

sections.title: COMPUTER ORGANIZATION & ARCHITECTURE TOPIC: SEQUENTIAL CIRCUITS
sections.description:
Guest lecture was conducted by MCA department on 20/05/2024 from 10.30am to 12.30pm. Chief guest Dr. K. Adisesha, HOD at SJES College of Management Studies, Bengaluru has taken a lecture on topic “Sequential Circuits” for first year MCA students. He has published number of papers in National and International Journals. He has delivered lectures in various organizations and universities. Total of around 30 students and staff participated in this programme.

The speaker explains the basics of Digital Circuits, Sequential Circuits, Shift Registers, Counters, Multiplexers, Encoder and Decoder. After his session students were given time to interact with him and they were benefited from this lecture.

sections.title: INDUSTRIAL VISIT TO ISRO (U. R. RAO SATELLITE CENTRE)
sections.description:
An industrial visit was arranged on June 12th, 2024 for MCA students.

The visit was to ISRO (U. R. Rao Satellite Centre) at Bengaluru.

The students were exposed to a lot of scientific marvels. They were shown the Chanrdayaan – 3 landing procedures by way of video.

The students were taken to the live workplace of the satellite integration process and also taken around the exhibition area where various models were exhibited.

Students got firsthand information on the making and working of satellites.
